description: Source code for 'ck' library providing C11 Annex K wrappers and validation functions, including memory clearing, string error handling, constant-time memory comparison, backtrace generation, and assertion handling.

methods.name: ck_memclear_s
methods.description: Securely clears memory with various platform-specific implementations, ensuring no sensitive data remains.

methods.name: ck_strerror_s
methods.description: Provides thread-safe string representation of error numbers.

methods.name: ck_memeq_const_time
methods.description: Performs constant-time memory comparison for equality, mitigating timing attacks.

methods.name: ck_memeq_const_time_fixed_len
methods.description: Performs constant-time comparison for fixed-length memory blocks.

methods.name: ck_calloc
methods.description: Allocates zero-initialized memory and asserts success.

methods.name: ck_realloc_u32
methods.description: Reallocates memory for a list with additional elements, ensuring size constraints.

methods.name: ck_backtrace
methods.description: Generates a stack backtrace using libunwind, if available.

methods.name: ck_bt
methods.description: Logs a backtrace with filename, line, and message.

methods.name: ck_assert_failed
methods.description: Logs assertion failure details and aborts.
